text:
alex: spotted plaintext DB URL in partner chart upload to staging: gs://redwood-staging-charts/partner-s/1.2.0/values.yaml -> DATABASE_URL=postgresql://svc_batch:passw0rd@staging-db:5432/batchdb

priya: path and snippet?

alex: under `extra.env` - copied file to gs://sec-evidence/SEC-3751/values.yaml and removed public ACL.

samir: Triage: staging-only likely. Plan: (1) restrict partner SA write, (2) rotate DB user with ephemeral creds, (3) snapshot audit logs, (4) scan Vault for wrapped blobs referencing transit keys.

oncall: removing objectCreator for partner-ci@partner now and moving object to quarantine bucket.

security-bot: Incident created: SEC-3751. Triage owner: @samir. Follow rotation runbook.

priya: I'll run the log search: `gcloud logging read 'textPayload:"svc_batch"' --limit 500`

samir: alex, when you rotate, write new creds to Vault at secret/data/staging/db/svc_batch_rot1 and mark old secret deprecated. Use ConfigSync canary to one pod.

alex: rotate started: `./infra/scripts/pg-rotate-user.sh --db=staging-db --user=svc_batch --to=svc_batch_rot1`

oncall: IAM change applied at 3751234520 - partner-ci@partner removed from roles/storage.objectCreator for staging charts.

priya: Found Vault entries for secret/partner-s/* with `wrapped_blob` referencing `transit-main`. We'll need a rewrap if any app bundles reference it. Snapshotting audits now.

samir: Good. Run canary after write and monitor for DB auth failures. If canary healthy, revoke old creds and run controlled rewrap using rewrap-temp key.

alex: new creds written to Vault at secret/data/staging/db/svc_batch_rot1, canary triggered.

security-bot: Update SEC-3751: canary healthy, old user revoked, partner SA write restricted. Follow-ups: infra to add server-side scanning on partner uploads; partner-security to update onboarding checklist.

priya: I'll author a short retro and add a runbook snippet for partner uploads.

samir: Thanks. Closing thread after retro published.
